name: Super Shot
design_intent: TUTORIAL 2 of 4. Lesson: PRESS+RELEASE SUPER TO LAUNCH. A wide open chimney (two bumper columns purely as visual rails, 1000px apart — never a tight squeeze) with the goal ring 2000px straight above the start floor. Numbers vs Tuning: super impulse 2800 px/s from rest => apex v^2/2g = 2800^2/3200 = 2450px > 2000 (clean one-shot with 450px margin); plain-boost climb could theoretically reach 2660px on a full tank but takes ~2.9s of sustained thrust vs the super's instant pop — the hint sells the intended verb, and a player who climbs it anyway has still learned to fly. Floor is trampoline so a missed launch lands soft and each floor touch refunds +20 fuel toward the retry (super fires at ANY fuel >= 5, so retries are nearly instant). No void — zero-stakes teaching space.
hint: PRESS + RELEASE  X / K  —  SUPER LAUNCH!
